source_contract.formula: productPrice + (manual mode ? proof[manualProofType] : 0) + sum(selected applied option prices) + (design mode ? designServices[selectedID] : 0); toFixed(2)

scope: Every saved supported product DOM quote in the frozen metadata; row linkage restricted to the selected run. Detached quotes remain explicitly unresolved.
